title: R4 · wedge tip
changes: 13 mm thick, wedging smoothly down from the black dot to a 4 mm point (side and robot photos).
Tip narrowed: the inner edge runs straight into a small point on the outer edge.
Smooth concave blend where the blade starts, instead of a jog.
Slots made fatter (2.7 x 1.6 mm); the half-hidden head hole made round.
Head honeycomb left as traced: the reviewer counted 8 full holes plus 1 small one, the same as the model.
review: The wedge starts with a visible crease at the dot; the robot photo shows a smooth chamfer.
Slots overshot: the photo's are narrower and longer (about 2.2:1), the model's are about 1.4:1.
The top-left head hole touches the outer edge; the photo shows a wall around it.
Three bar holes are slanted ovals; the photo reads them as slightly smaller round holes.
The tip still ends in a short flat; the photo rounds into a sharper point.
A small kink remains on the head's outer edge.
